description: Traffic Signal Change and Clearance Interval Pooled Fund Study Utah BSM Trajectories is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Automobiles", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation. This dataset contains timestamped Basic Safety Messages (BSMs) collected from connected vehicles operating in Utah from vendor PANASONIC as part of the ITS JPO's Traffic Signal Change and Clearance Interval Pooled Fund Study. The data includes GPS location, speed, heading, accelerations, and brake status at 10 Hz frequency. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Automobiles". It has 25 columns, among them TEMP_ID, HEADING_DEGREES, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, ELEVATION_METERS, TMSTP_UTC. The portal shows 2025-10-24 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
